caseNameFull: Pierre v. Jordan, Secretary of State of California
attorneys: Petitioners pro se. Thomas C. Lynch, Attorney General of California, Burton J. Gindler and A. Wallace Tashima, Deputy Attorneys General, and Harold W. Kennedy for respondents.

opinions.text: Motion of petitioners to strike respondents' brief denied. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit denied.
